Client chat UI and navigation committed as 020d31d (T8.1-T8.16, T9.1-T9.3, T10.1, T10.5). All 64 tasks are now marked complete in tasks.json. Gates run: server typecheck pass, client typecheck pass, client lint pass, client build pass. The implementation gate remains PENDING for two honest reasons. (1) /sdrive:verify still reports fail (matched 20, missing 86, extra 283), and every missing item is a tooling false negative that cannot be fixed here because CON-705 forbids editing .sdrive/scripts: verify.js CANDIDATE_ROOTS has no 'client' entry so client/ is never scanned (all 13 'missing' components exist on disk), detectDependencies reads only the workspace-root package.json which has no dependencies in a pnpm workspace (all 9 dependencies are installed), detectEntities only understands SQL/Prisma/TypeORM/plain interfaces and not Mongoose Schema models (all 7 entities exist), and plan.json stores full '/api/workspaces/:slug/...' endpoint paths while routers declare relative paths (17 route declarations exist). (2) The CON-703 browser check was NOT performed: no MongoDB is available in this environment (nothing listening on 127.0.0.1:27017, no mongod or MongoDB service installed), so the app cannot be started to check empty, loading, error, keyboard and narrow-screen states.

Plan amended at the user's direction to record the implementation drift and to replace the two directory placeholders with concrete file names: the chat-scoped member directory (GET /chat/members, needed because GET /members requires users:read which Viewers lack, blocking FR-014 and FR-025 for them), the Notification model change (chat.mention type, task made optional, channel/message refs) required by FR-015, the activity _id on the listener payload required by T7.2, the pre-existing utils/api.ts type fix, and 10 additional component files. plan.json now has 53 components, 8 entities and 17 API contracts; an amendment log was added to plan.md. Re-running verify after the amendment gives matched 27 (up from 20), missing 107 (up from 86) because the concrete client file names still cannot be matched while verify.js does not scan client/. That the number worsens as the plan becomes more accurate is the clearest evidence that the failure is in the tool, not the code.
